declaration.preface:
This Responsible Labour and Human Rights Policy (“Policy”) is developed and implemented by Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd (“the Company”) to ensure fair, ethical, and responsible labour practices and to uphold human rights across its operations.

The Company integrates respect for labour standards and human rights into its daily operations, business practices, and interactions with employees, workers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. This Policy defines the Company’s commitments, key focus areas, and mechanisms for implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

The Company adopts appropriate policies, procedures, and best practices to promote safe, fair, and inclusive working conditions and fosters a culture of respect, dignity, and accountability across all levels of the organization.
declaration.declaration:
I, the undersigned employee of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd., hereby acknowledge my understanding and commitment to the Company’s Responsible Labour and Human Rights framework and confirm the following:

I confirm that I have received the Responsible Labour and Human Rights Policy

I have read and understood its purpose, scope, and requirements

I understand how the policy applies to my role and workplace activities

I agree to comply with all applicable labour laws, company policies, and human rights requirements

I will follow fair, ethical, and lawful workplace practices in all my activities

I will support the Company’s commitment to responsible labour and human rights standards

I will participate in training and awareness programs related to labour rights and workplace conduct

I will contribute to maintaining a respectful, inclusive, and safe work environment

I will support initiatives aimed at improving workplace practices and employee well-being

I will report any concerns, violations, or risks related to labour practices or human rights

I will use the designated grievance mechanisms responsibly and without fear of retaliation

I will communicate improvement opportunities to the HR Manager

I acknowledge that responsible labour practices and respect for human rights are ongoing responsibilities

I commit to supporting continuous improvement in workplace practices and ethical conduct
declaration.scope: This Responsible Labour and Human Rights Policy (“Policy”) applies to all operations, activities, and facilities of Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd (“the Company”). It is applicable to all employees at all levels, as well as contract workers, suppliers, service providers, business partners, and any other individuals or entities working on behalf of the Company.

focusAreas: Child Labour, Forced Labour & Human Trafficking

Overall Responsible Labour and Human Rig: To ensure a safe, healthy, and secure working environment for all employees, contractors, and associated personnel across all operations.
To uphold and respect internationally recognized human rights principles by promoting fair, ethical, and dignified treatment of all individuals.
To ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, and relevant human rights standards.
To prohibit and eliminate all forms of child labour, forced labour, and human trafficking within operations and the supply chain.
To promote equality, diversity, and inclusion by preventing discrimination and harassment in the workplace.
To ensure fair, transparent, and equitable compensation and benefits practices in line with applicable laws and industry standards.
To promote responsible labour practices across the supply chain by encouraging adherence to human rights and labour standards among business partners.
To foster a workplace culture based on dignity, respect, and ethical conduct in all interactions.
To encourage employee participation and effective communication through appropriate grievance and feedback mechanisms.
To promote awareness and understanding of labour rights and human rights principles through training and engagement initiatives.
Approach: Prevent, Comply and Improve: Potential risks related to labour practices and human rights are identified, assessed, and addressed through appropriate policies, procedures, and operational controls.
The Company complies with all applicable labour laws, regulations, and statutory requirements, and aligns its practices with recognized human rights principles and standards.
The Company promotes continuous improvement in labour practices and human rights performance through regular monitoring, evaluation, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Child Labour, Forced Labour and Human Tr: Implement a strict zero-tolerance policy integrated into all HR and operational procedures
Strengthen robust age verification system at the time of recruitment with documented proof retention
Conduct mandatory contract worker screening and internal workforce screening for forced labour risks
Conduct annual human rights risk assessments covering all sites and functions
Provide mandatory annual training on human rights, child labour prevention, and ethical recruitment for all employees and HR staff
Establish a confidential grievance mechanism for reporting violations anonymously
Conduct internal compliance audits and corrective action tracking system
Discrimination and Harassment Prevention: Ensure employees are fully aware of grievance mechanisms related to discrimination and harassment through regular communication, training, and awareness initiatives
Ensure all reported cases of discrimination and harassment are promptly and fairly investigated in accordance with defined internal procedures and timelines
Ensure timely resolution of all cases, with no pending cases remaining unresolved beyond the defined closure period
Conduct regular workplace risk assessments to identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks related to discrimination and harassment across all operations
Respectful Workplace and Dignity at Work: Ensure all employees acknowledge and understand workplace conduct and dignity-related policies
Conduct regular behavioral awareness and ethics training for all employees to strengthen respectful workplace culture
Maintain a zero-tolerance approach towards severe misconduct, ensuring strict adherence to disciplinary standards
Promote and sustain a positive workplace culture based on mutual respect, collaboration, and ethical behavior
Ensure all disciplinary actions are properly recorded and documented in accordance with established procedures
Employee Health, Safety and Well-being: Maintain a safe working environment with zero tolerance for fatal accidents and life-threatening incidents
Conduct regular health and safety risk assessments across all operations to identify, evaluate, and mitigate workplace hazards
Ensure all employees receive appropriate safety training to promote awareness, safe practices, and risk prevention
Carry out statutory inspections and audits in compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements
Ensure timely implementation and closure of all corrective and preventive actions arising from audits, inspections, and incidents
Promote employee health and well-being through periodic medical check-ups in line with regulatory and organizational requirements
Working Conditions and Fair Employment P: Ensure full compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory regulations across all operations
Ensure all employees are engaged under formal and legally compliant employment contracts
Conduct regular internal audits to monitor and strengthen compliance with labour and employment standards
Maintain strict adherence to regulatory requirements with no critical non-compliance in workplace practices
Ensure fair, transparent, and compliant management of working hours, wages, and employee benefits in line with legal requirements
Equitable Compensation and Benefits: Ensure full compliance with all applicable statutory wage requirements across the organization
Conduct regular compensation benchmarking to ensure fairness, competitiveness, and alignment with industry standards
Promote equitable pay practices by minimizing unjustified pay disparities across similar roles
Ensure all eligible employees are fully covered under applicable statutory benefits in accordance with legal requirements
Social Dialogue and Employee Engagement: Conduct regular employee engagement sessions to strengthen communication, feedback, and workplace participation
Encourage broad employee participation in engagement surveys to capture meaningful feedback and improve workplace practices
Ensure employee representation is included in relevant decision-making processes related to workplace policies and practices
Promote a culture of recognition by implementing structured employee appreciation and reward initiatives across all departments
Career Development and Training: Ensure all employees are provided training opportunities in line with the defined competency and training matrix
Promote a culture of continuous learning by ensuring all assigned training programs are completed effectively
Encourage skill development through regular training initiatives to enhance employee capabilities and performance
Ensure all new employees receive structured induction and onboarding within the defined onboarding period
Promote internal career growth by prioritizing internal talent development and advancement opportunities within the organization

responsibilities.duty: Provide strategic oversight of labour and human rights framework; ensure alignment with organizational values and objectives; allocate financial, human, and operational resources; engage with regulatory authorities and stakeholders; oversee risk identification and mitigation; review performance and drive continuous improvement

Implement and monitor Labour and Human Rights Policy; ensure compliance with labour laws and human rights standards; manage grievance redressal mechanisms; coordinate training and awareness programs; maintain records and compliance documentation

Conduct audits and inspections related to labour and human rights; investigate incidents and ensure corrective actions; maintain monitoring and reporting systems; recommend policy improvements; liaise with auditors and external stakeholders

policy.monitoring:
At Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd., structured monitoring and reporting systems are established to track labour and human rights performance and ensure continuous improvement.

Monitoring: Key labour and human rights parameters such as workplace safety, grievance management, training coverage, and compliance status are monitored against defined KPIs on a periodic basis. Performance data is compiled and reviewed to assess trends and progress.

Internal Audits: Labour and human rights compliance audits are conducted periodically to evaluate adherence to applicable laws, internal policies, and standards. Audit findings are reported to management and corrective actions are tracked to closure.

Management Review: Senior management reviews labour and human rights performance, audit outcomes, and progress against targets at defined intervals. Outputs from these reviews are used to strengthen systems and drive continuous improvement.

Documentation & Data Management: Accurate records are maintained for employee data, training, grievances, and compliance activities to ensure transparency, traceability, and effective decision-making.

Reporting & Disclosure: Labour and human rights performance is communicated through internal reporting systems and external disclosures, where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Responsible Labour and Human Rights Policy is subject to periodic evaluation by HR Manager at least once every two years or earlier if required due to regulatory changes, operational developments, audit findings, or stakeholder feedback, to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with evolving legal requirements, regulatory standards, and organizational priorities.

The review encompasses an assessment of compliance status, effectiveness of labour and human rights practices, progress against established objectives, and inputs from employees, internal audits, and relevant stakeholders. Based on this evaluation, necessary updates are incorporated to strengthen the policy framework and ensure alignment with applicable laws, industry best practices, and the Company’s commitment to continuous improvement in labour and human rights performance.
